Unmodified upstream files pinned to https://github.com/btopro/mespeak/tree/078d6597254776c151c67f73434c91be034a9fdc . Source and documentation: https://www.masswerk.at/mespeak/ ; https://github.com/kripken/speak.js ; https://espeak.sourceforge.net/ . The voice engine runs locally and receives no network requests containing customer names.
